_what: A frozen copy of the working system: the exact arrangement that produced the two delivered edits. Nothing here is a proposal — every value was read back out of the delivered files and their plans. When a new style is built, it is built BESIDE this, never on top of it.
rule: do not edit this file. A different look is a different pack.

engine.behaviour: director default (lyric): one image per card, held
engine.sound_design: default cues_for (riser, impact, whoosh, tick, swell)
engine.crf: 23 with the look layer on, preset medium
engine.caption_rule: one card at a time, one line on it, never stacked

reproduce: python -m studio.pipeline --video footage/post2/videoplayback.mp4 --audio footage/post2/<song>.mp3 --cards studio/out/<name>.cards.json --brief <name> --font Gefika --start <start> --end <end> --out studio/out/<name>.mp4
# add --colour FFD400 for the Bangla edit; the Zaalima edit leaves it white
# no --style: house is the default, and --style house is the same thing
